title: FireworkCooldown
description: Adds a cooldown to firework rockets.
body:
# FireworkCooldown

Cooldown for firework rockets.

## Features
- Lightweight and configurable.
- Server-side only.
- Works on Paper/Spigot/Purpur.

## Config (snippet)
```yml
cooldown-seconds: 5
message: "&cItem is on cooldown."
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
